name: itsz-tdeck-realtime-gps-compass
description: Use GPS course as a near-real-time compass heading source on the ITSZ T-Deck, refresh compass-capable frames faster when GPS heading is available, apply the low-color ITSZ Classic T-Deck UI skin, patch the TFT map for safer SD tile/path handling plus dynamic node centering, add an on-device internet/satellite map cache menu, make map/message/signal status explicit on the pager UI, add polished map waiting/status cards and TX/RX chips, add a Tools screen-correction sequence, and force physical USB API access for field recovery.

targetDevice.sdCard: 32GB installed; firmware mount not yet API-verified

lastKnownWorkingRuntime.status: Working and configured on 2026-05-31 after flashing the 20260530-222402 Z-Deck UI polish build. The T-Deck enumerated as COM17, completed Meshtastic serial API handshakes, reported firmware 2.8.0.itsz1, owner ITSZ T-Deck / TDK, LongFast primary, and ITSZPriv secondary.

customBuild.ui: Low-color black/white/green palette closer to the original Meshtastic look, with explicit mesh idle, map source/GPS, a centered map waiting card when GPS/tiles are not ready, and compact TX/RX status chips for sent/heard/ack/fail.

build.status: WSL build path produced flashable t-deck-tft images. The 20260530-222402 build includes the ITSZ Classic UI skin, dynamic/safe TFT map patch, on-device internet/satellite map menu, explicit mesh idle/map source/message delivery labels, polished map waiting/status card, clearer TX/RX status chips, forced physical USB serial API access, recovery controls, SD message journal, and Tools -> Screen Correction. Flash completed and esptool verified writes on COM16; normal boot later enumerated as COM17 and Meshtastic API verification passed.

flash.pendingReason: No pending flash action. Runtime API verified on COM17 after normal reset; owner and public channel names restored, and ITSZPriv secondary channel name verified without exposing secret material.
